entries.title: Psalms 132:1
segments: ¶<<A Song of degrees.>> Jehovah, remember for David all his affliction;

entries.title: Psalms 132:2
segments: How he swore unto Jehovah, vowed unto the Mighty One of Jacob:

entries.title: Psalms 132:3
segments: I will not come into the tent of my house, I will not go up to the couch of my bed;

entries.title: Psalms 132:4
segments: I will not give sleep to mine eyes, slumber to mine eyelids,

entries.title: Psalms 132:5
segments: Until I find out a place for Jehovah, habitations for the Mighty One of Jacob. ...

entries.title: Psalms 132:6
segments: Behold, we heard of it at Ephratah, we found it in the fields of the wood.

entries.title: Psalms 132:7
segments: Let us go into his habitations, let us worship at his footstool.

entries.title: Psalms 132:8
segments: Arise, Jehovah, into thy rest, thou and the ark of thy strength.

entries.title: Psalms 132:9
segments: Let thy priests be clothed with righteousness, and let thy saints shout for joy.

entries.title: Psalms 132:10
segments: For thy servant David's sake, turn not away the face of thine anointed.

entries.title: Psalms 132:11
segments: ¶Jehovah hath sworn [in] truth unto David; he will not turn from it: Of the fruit of thy body will I set upon thy throne;

entries.title: Psalms 132:12
segments: If thy children keep my covenant, and my testimonies which I will teach them, their children also for evermore shall sit upon thy throne.

entries.title: Psalms 132:13
segments: For Jehovah hath chosen Zion; he hath desired it for his dwelling:

entries.title: Psalms 132:14
segments: This is my rest for ever; here will I dwell, for I have desired it.

entries.title: Psalms 132:15
segments: I will abundantly bless her provision; I will satisfy her needy ones with bread;

entries.title: Psalms 132:16
segments: And I will clothe her priests with salvation, and her saints shall shout aloud for joy.

entries.title: Psalms 132:17
segments: There will I cause the horn of David to bud forth; I have ordained a lamp for mine anointed.

entries.title: Psalms 132:18
segments: His enemies will I clothe with shame; but upon himself shall his crown flourish.
